description: Apply part of a held deposit to one invoice: it records that amount as a PAYMENT through the invoice server. amount_minor defaults to the lesser of held and owed. More than either, or a pre-arrival date, is refused.

amount_minor.description: How much of the deposit to apply, in minor units. Defaults to the smaller of what is held and what the invoice still owes

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the deposit was set against the invoice. Defaults to today

id.description: Deposit id such as DEP-2026-0001, or an exact client name

invoice.description: The invoice number to apply it to, e.g. INV-2026-0001

note.description: Free text kept on the application row

name: deposit_apply
title: Apply a deposit to an invoice
